subject: humanities
passage: The earliest daguerreotypes, one of the first practical forms of photography, were introduced in 1839, and a single portrait could require an exposure lasting several minutes. Anyone who moved during that time would appear as a blur. Studios therefore supplied hidden metal stands to brace a sitter's head and neck, helping the person remain ______ until the image was complete.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

explanation.why: Anyone who moved during the long exposure "would appear as a blur," so studios used stands to brace the sitter's head. The purpose of the brace was to keep the person from moving, so "motionless" fits.
explanation.A: Incorrect. The problem the text describes is movement causing blur, not the sitter's mood.
explanation.B: Incorrect. It was the stands that were hidden; the sitter had to appear clearly in the portrait.
explanation.C: Correct. Movement caused blur, so the stands helped sitters stay motionless during the long exposure.
explanation.D: Incorrect. Nothing in the text concerns how far the sitter was from the camera.
